轨迹从已经形成的原恒星开始。它收缩并释放引力能；背景星云是环境示意，轨迹不计算分: The track begins with an already formed protostar. It contracts and releases gravitational energy. The nebula is an environmental illustration; cloud collapse and accretion are not calculated.
核心氢逐渐变成氦。压力与引力维持近似平衡；这里的颗粒纹理是动态美术，没有把表面噪: Core hydrogen gradually becomes helium. Pressure and gravity remain approximately balanced. The animated granulation is artwork, not a convection calculation.
核心的氢接近耗尽，燃烧转向壳层。外层膨胀、表面变冷，但总光度仍可能很高。: Core hydrogen is nearly exhausted and burning moves into shells. The envelope expands and its surface cools, while total luminosity can remain high.
核心氦参与形成碳和氧。低质量模型在此之前经历氦闪；阶段按钮是按中心丰度提取的展示: Helium burning helps form carbon and oxygen. The low-mass models experienced a helium flash earlier. Stage buttons are browsing markers extracted from central abundances.
碳氧核心之外，氦与氢的壳层交替活动。真实记录里的热脉冲保留在 HR 轨迹中，可以: Helium and hydrogen shells alternate outside the carbon–oxygen core. Thermal pulses in the real records remain visible on the HR track; inspect them record by record.
大部分外层已离开模型中的恒星。裸露核心向高温移动，抛出的气体可以被照亮；气体点云: Most of the envelope has left the model star. The exposed core heats up and can illuminate expelled gas. The point cloud only illustrates mass loss.
核燃烧已经很弱，致密核心继续冷却。本记录只到仍然很热的白矮星，没有计算到黑矮星。: Nuclear burning is now weak and the compact core cools. This record ends with a still-hot white dwarf; it does not extend to a black dwarf.
中心燃料继续向更重元素推进，越来越短的阶段被压缩在真实年龄的尾端。铁核形成后，核: Central fuel proceeds toward heavier elements. Increasingly brief stages occupy the final moments of physical age. Once an iron core forms, fusion cannot support it indefinitely.
这里是原始计算的最后一条有效记录。低质量记录到热白矮星；大质量记录到铁核快速内落: This is the last valid source record. Low-mass tracks reach hot white dwarfs; massive tracks reach rapid iron-core infall. Explosion and remnant are not calculated.
点曲线，跳到那一刻: Click a curve to visit that moment
沿恒星 HR 轨迹选择记录: Select a record along the stellar HR track
左热右冷 · 标点按同一真实年龄: Hotter left · markers share a physical age
先比较初始质量。所有读数来自同一研究中的真实 MESA 记录，单星、无自转、太阳: Compare initial masses. Every reading comes from real MESA records in the same study: single, nonrotating stars at solar metallicity.
赫罗图左热右冷。点击轨迹可以精确选择记录；相邻阶段可能相差几百万年，也可能只差很: The HR diagram is hotter on the left. Click a track to select a record. Adjacent stages may be millions of years apart or separated by a brief moment.
剖面按质量坐标展开，不是实际半径剖面。点击球壳，读出核心质量，再看中心氢、氦、碳: The cutaway uses mass coordinates, not physical radius. Click a shell to inspect core masses, then watch central hydrogen, helium, carbon and oxygen change.
低质量轨迹到热白矮星，高质量轨迹止于坍缩前。结局视图是可比较的条件示意，不是给每: Low-mass tracks reach hot white dwarfs; high-mass tracks stop before collapse. Ending views compare conditional illustrations, without assigning every star a fixed remnant.
历史轨迹未能载入。可以重试。: Historical tracks could not load. Please retry.
把漫长的生命，放在眼前。: A long life, brought into view.
不接续原始演化轨迹: Not a continuation of the source track
中心，不是整颗星的成分: The centre, not the whole star
风与抛壳由源模型的质量变化表示；点云不是流体计算。此账本不另追踪辐射的质能亏损。: Winds and envelope loss appear as source-model mass changes. The cloud is not fluid dynamics. This ledger does not separately track radiative mass–energy loss.
相对于三类核功率之和，绝非中心丰度。引力储能、中微子和光子输出不在同一瞬间简单相: Fractions of the three nuclear powers, not central abundances. Gravitational storage, neutrinos and photon output do not simply balance instantaneously.
黑体色度积分，曝光独立归一化。: Blackbody colour integration; exposure normalized independently.
半径以对数压缩显示，不能用屏幕直径比较真实大小。: Radii are logarithmically compressed; screen diameters cannot be used to compare physical sizes.
同屏光球按真实半径比例缩放；相机适配最大的一颗，致密小星可能小到难以看见。: Photospheres share a linear radius scale. The camera fits the largest star; compact stars may become hard to see.
对照按同一真实年龄；† 表示该轨迹已经结束，只保留终点。: Comparisons share a physical age. † marks an ended track held at its endpoint.
坍缩之后，条件决定分支: After collapse, conditions shape the branch
源记录没有爆炸、遗迹质量和反冲速度。自转、金属丰度、双星相互作用及爆炸能量都会影: The source has no explosion, remnant mass or recoil velocity. Rotation, metallicity, binaries and explosion energy affect the outcome; initial mass is not a universal dividing line.
束流与吸积环只是可能环境，不表示遗迹必有喷流或吸积盘；此处未做引力透镜计算。: Beams and accretion rings are possible surroundings, not required features. Gravitational lensing is not calculated here.
MESA r12115 · Farag 等 2020 · 单星、无自转、太阳金属: MESA r12115 · Farag et al. 2020 · single, nonrotating, solar-metallicity stars. The 1 and 3 M☉ models reach hot white dwarfs; 15 and 25 M☉ reach iron-core infall. Stage thresholds only aid browsing.

这不是预测剩余寿命。: This is not a prediction of remaining life.
真实年龄插值保留对数温度、光度与半径；轨迹按误差阈值简化，最近保留模型号可检查。: Physical-age interpolation retains logarithmic temperature, luminosity and radius. Tracks are simplified with bounded errors and original model numbers remain inspectable. Stellar structure equations are not rerun.
半径按质量立方根展开；不是密度或真实半径剖面。中心亮点是示意。按钮读区间质量，点: Radii follow the cube root of mass, not physical density or radius. The bright centre is illustrative. Buttons give interval masses; select one for enclosed mass.
